messages.subject: GCC Executive Profile | Energy, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Norlynx Team,

Your Dubai-based executive search work across energy, commodities and international markets makes this a relevant introduction for my GCC-focused search.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory engagement, ESG, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications in a major natural-resources operation.

I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates, with Saudi Arabia and the UAE as priority markets, followed by the wider GCC. My strongest fit sits where institutional relationships, regulatory execution, responsible development and commercial strategy intersect.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
